correctness.rationale: The right-greedy unique embedding partitions deletion-pair types and yields B2=1+S(S+3)/2-e-J-R. The q-ary modular-increment bijection makes transitions independent Bernoulli and each nonzero-run reversal independently Bernoulli(1/(q-1)), so R|T is binomial(J,a). Centered square-free Bernoulli monomials prove the exact first two moments; at n=2 B2=1. An independently written enumeration checked 1,260 source words and their conditional distributions; finite tests are only corroboration.
